mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the money's worth given in exchange by the buyer of an asset to the seller."
Consideration is the money's worth given in exchange by the buyer of an asset to the seller.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the levying of tax on the same items by different tax authorities."
Double Taxation Relief Double taxation is the levying of tax on the same items by different tax authorities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the money paid to the government by manufacturing concerns on goods produced."
Excise duty is the money paid to the government by manufacturing concerns on goods produced.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is responsible for the due administration of the petroleum profits tax."
The Federal Board of Inland Revenue is responsible for the due administration of the petroleum profits tax.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a fairly accurate measurement of the growth of an economy since purchasing power of the naira Increases with economic growth."
The yield from VAT is a fairly accurate measurement of the growth of an economy since purchasing power of the naira Increases with economic growth.
fib: ______ is the refund or credit mechanism which eliminates the cascading effects, that is a feature of the retail sales tax.
In-built in the new tax is the refund or credit mechanism which eliminates the cascading effects, that is a feature of the retail sales tax.
______ is a multiple stage tax, it has a single effect and does not add more than the specified amount on the consumer price no matter the number of stages at which the tax is paid.
Even though VAT is a multiple stage tax, it has a single effect and does not add more than the specified amount on the consumer price no matter the number of stages at which the tax is paid.
______ is a replacement of the existing Sales Tax which has been in operation under Federal Government Legislation, Decree No.7 of 1986 but operated on the bases of residence.
VAT is a replacement of the existing Sales Tax which has been in operation under Federal Government Legislation, Decree No.7 of 1986 but operated on the bases of residence.
______ is the 25th items on the Exclusive Legislative List of the 1999 Constitution. 2.4 Summary Here, we have been exposed to other duties that government imposed on goods apart from stamp duties.

An export duty is the 25th items on the Exclusive Legislative List of the 1999 Constitution. 2.4 Summary Here, we have been exposed to other duties that government imposed on goods apart from stamp duties.
______ means a period of exemption from the payment of taxes imposed by the government and this exemption may be complete or partial. (Ayua I.A:1996:306).
Tax exemption simply means a period of exemption from the payment of taxes imposed by the government and this exemption may be complete or partial. (Ayua I.A:1996:306).
